name: MonarchSpaceSwitcher
title: SpaceSwitcher
wrapsNative: MonarchButton (ghost) with androidx.compose.material3.ExposedDropdownMenuDefaults.TrailingIcon opening androidx.compose.material3.ModalBottomSheet with MonarchSearchBar and an androidx.compose.foundation.lazy.LazyColumn of androidx.compose.foundation.selection.selectable rows with androidx.compose.material3.RadioButton; MonarchAvatar for icons
summary: Chooses which Space of the workspace the app shows, All spaces or one Space, from a button that opens a sheet with a searchable list, New Space and Manage Spaces.
whenToUse: In a product's top bar or navigation drawer, when the workspace is divided into Spaces and the person filters the app to one of them.
whenNotToUse: To switch between workspaces, use MonarchWorkspaceSwitcher. For a searchable choice inside a form, use MonarchCombobox.
api: @Composable fun MonarchSpaceSwitcher(spaces: List<MonarchSpaceOption>, selection: String?, onSelectionChange: (String?) -> Unit, modifier: Modifier = Modifier, size: MonarchButtonSize = MonarchButtonSize.Md, enabled: Boolean = true, allowsAll: Boolean = true, loading: Boolean = false, iconOnly: Boolean = false, hidesWhenEmpty: Boolean = true, allIcon: Painter? = null, onCreate: (() -> Unit)? = null, onManage: (() -> Unit)? = null, labels: MonarchSpaceSwitcherLabels = MonarchSpaceSwitcherLabels())
class MonarchSpaceOption(id: String, name: String, description: String? = null, icon: Painter? = null)

class MonarchSpaceSwitcherLabels(label: String? = null, all: String? = null, placeholder: String? = null, search: String? = null, empty: String? = null, loading: String? = null, create: String? = null, manage: String? = null, cancel: String? = null)

options.name: spaces
options.description: The Spaces this person can open, in display order.

options.name: selection
options.description: The chosen Space id, null for All spaces.

options.name: onSelectionChange
options.description: Called with the chosen Space id, or null for All spaces. Choosing the current one again does not call it.

options.name: size
options.description: The height and padding of the button.

options.name: enabled
options.description: Whether the sheet can be opened.

options.name: allowsAll
options.description: Offers All spaces first. Without it a Space must stay chosen and the button reads Choose a Space until one is.

options.name: loading
options.description: The Spaces are still loading; the sheet says Loading spaces… and the search field shows its pending state.

options.name: iconOnly
options.description: Shows only the icon and the arrow, for a narrow bar. TalkBack still reads the name.

options.name: hidesWhenEmpty
options.description: Draws nothing when there are no Spaces and nothing is loading.

options.name: allIcon
options.description: The decorative icon of All spaces; null shows a tinted tile with its initial.

options.name: onCreate
options.description: Adds New Space, which closes the sheet and runs this.

options.name: onManage
options.description: Adds Manage Spaces, which closes the sheet and runs this.

states.name: all spaces
states.description: Nothing chosen: the button shows All spaces; All spaces is marked in the list.

states.name: one space
states.description: The button shows the Space's icon and name; its row has the radio mark and the selected state.

states.name: no choice
states.description: With allowsAll false and nothing chosen the button reads Choose a Space.

states.name: searching
states.description: The list keeps the Spaces whose name or description contains the text, ignoring case and accents; All spaces is hidden; with no match it reads No spaces match.

states.name: loading
states.description: The list ends with Loading spaces….

states.name: empty
states.description: With no Spaces and nothing loading nothing is drawn, unless hidesWhenEmpty is false.

states.name: disabled
states.description: enabled false gives the ghost button's disabled colors and the sheet cannot open.

appearance: A ghost button with a square MonarchAvatar icon, the caption Space in muted text over the name, and the Material exposed-dropdown arrow. The sheet uses the raised surface, default text for names, muted text for descriptions and messages, and Material radio marks. All are theme roles, so light, dark and both high-contrast themes follow.
platformNotes: The parity map lists combobox as a dependency; MonarchCombobox is a labelled form field, so the switcher has its own button and the same sheet, search field and single-choice rows that MonarchCombobox's sheet presentation uses, as on iOS. The web opens a popover listbox (EntityPicker) with arrow keys and type to search; on a phone it is a modal bottom sheet. The web's tooltip on the collapsed trigger is the spoken value here, since a phone has no hover. manageHref, manageExternal and createHref are callbacks (onManage, onCreate): components do not navigate. The web's controlled open state and align are not offered. Space icons are Painters; Monarch bundles no icons. iOS names: selection with a Binding, isIconOnly and manageURL; Android hoists selection with onSelectionChange, drops the is prefix and takes onManage. Experimental: an identity product composite that waits for a Rook app to adopt it.
accessibility: The button is one element named "Space" whose state description is the current Space or All spaces, also when only the icon shows; it keeps a 48dp touch target.

Each row is a radio-button element read as the Space and its description ("Engineering, 18 members"), built by a tested pure function; the chosen row is selected and shows a radio mark, so the choice does not depend on color.
The title of the sheet is a heading; Loading spaces… and No spaces match. are polite live regions.
Rows, New Space, Manage Spaces and Cancel are at least 48dp high; Cancel and the system back gesture close the sheet without a change.
edgeCases: A selection that is not in spaces reads as All spaces (or Choose a Space without allowsAll).
With allowsAll false the All spaces row is not offered, so the choice cannot be cleared.
Choosing the current Space again closes the sheet without calling onSelectionChange.
The search text is cleared when the sheet closes.
Long names wrap in the sheet; the button grows with the text.

examples.setupTemplate:
var space by remember { mutableStateOf<String?>(null) }
val uriHandler = LocalUriHandler.current
val spaces = listOf(
    MonarchSpaceOption({{spaces.0.id}}, {{spaces.0.name}}, {{spaces.0.description}}),
    MonarchSpaceOption({{spaces.1.id}}, {{spaces.1.name}}, {{spaces.1.description}}),
    MonarchSpaceOption({{spaces.2.id}}, {{spaces.2.name}}, {{spaces.2.description}}),
    MonarchSpaceOption({{spaces.3.id}}, {{spaces.3.name}}, {{spaces.3.description}}),
)

examples.title: A Space must stay chosen, icon only
examples.code:
MonarchSpaceSwitcher(
    spaces = listOf(MonarchSpaceOption("eng", "Engineering"), MonarchSpaceOption("mkt", "Marketing")),
    selection = space,
    onSelectionChange = { space = it },
    allowsAll = false,
    iconOnly = true,
)

parityExceptions.reason: The web names this control with one sentence ("Space: All spaces"). On Android TalkBack gets the control name and its current value as the control's name and state description ("Space", "All spaces"), which it speaks as one phrase and announces again when the value changes; the same words are visible in the control.
parityExceptions.convention: a control has a name and a state, not a joined sentence (Android accessibility: contentDescription + stateDescription)
